{{Quote|I want to acquire some samples for synthesis, to distribute it among our troops, after I've tested its safety, of course.|Franges|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Franges''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Serving on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Quesh war]], Franges was stationed at the [[Imperial Waystation|Empire's forward outpost]] where his forces intercepted a transmission from the [[Three Families]] about an experimental formula being moved to the nearby [[Attis Station]] for testing. An [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] and [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]] addict, Franges sought to acquire it for himself before giving it his troops, and so recruited Imperial forces to retrieve the formula.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Franges appears on Quesh in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], where he gives Imperial players the mission "Adrenal Appropriation."<ref name="TOR" />
